title: Persian interface direction
decision: Treat Persian (fa), Urdu (ur), and Arabic (ar) as right-to-left interface locales. All other currently supported interface locales retain the left-to-right fallback.
rationale: Persian uses a right-to-left writing system. The locale registry already includes Persian, so leaving the document direction as LTR causes incorrect layout semantics and reading order.
constraints: Do not couple interface direction to the direction of individual chapter content.
Do not change translations or add locales in this change.
Preserve LTR behavior for all other supported locales.
validation: Full platform build and Cloudflare source validation
